metadata.title: A note on the BRST-BV Formalism Explanation of Deformation Quantization and Algebraic Index Theorem
metadata.abstract: In this note, we begin with considering the simple one-dimensional field theory describing a single free particle on manifold, and apply the BRST formalism and BV quantization to this model following the standard procedures in physics. Through calculations that, while not fully rigorous, have a more transparent physical interpretation, then subsequent geometric identifications, we recover the deformation quantization and algebraic index theorem on symplectic manifold. This note thus elucidates the physical origins and mechanisms of these mathematical results.

analysis.workSummary: 从流形上单个自由粒子的一维场论出发，应用BRST形式与BV量子化。以有物理解释的计算和后续几何识别恢复辛流形上的形变量子化及代数指标定理。
techniques: 自由粒子模型与几何识别
analysis.breakthrough: 给已知量子化和指标结果提供物理来源与机制的说明。
analysis.limitations: 作者明确计算并非完全严格。结论的定位是推导说明。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
